options.name: free_form
options.description: This module takes a free form command, as a string. There is not an actual option named "free form".  See the examples! V(flush_handlers) makes Ansible run any handler tasks which have thus far been notified. Ansible inserts these tasks internally at certain points to implicitly trigger handler runs (after pre/post tasks, the final role execution, and the main tasks section of your plays).
